title: The portfolio
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Chloe asks to see the portfolio he told her about. There are two drawings in it. One is the crab.

panels.composition: Wood's bedroom. CHLOE holding a portfolio case — cheap, black, new. WOOD not stopping her. BARNABY watching from the bed.

balloons.text: The portfolio. You said you were 'working on it.'

image.prompt: a young woman opening a cheap black portfolio case in a bedroom while a young man stands with his arms crossed and a small dog watches from the bed, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Inside: two sheets. The crab flyer, original. And the estuary from the spring special, 1998.
props: two drawings in a portfolio: a crab and an estuary

image.prompt: close-up of an open portfolio case holding exactly two drawings: a large hatched crab and a wide estuary landscape
a young woman holding up a drawing of a crab with a flat expression while a young man corrects her

panels.composition: Chloe putting them back with more care than she wants to show. Wood watching her hands.

balloons.text: They're good, Wood. That's the problem. They're good and there are two of them.

image.prompt: a young woman carefully sliding two drawings back into a portfolio case while a young man watches her hands, black and white

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Two drawings. Both from years ago. Chloe's line is the arc's thesis.
